description: This inventory assembles glacier-related hazards along the China-Pakistan Economic Corridor. Chinese Academy of Sciences institutes and collaborators compile watershed boundaries, glaciers, glacial lakes, drainage systems, surge glaciers and historical ice-dammed-lake outburst events. Other components identify potential glacier-flood or debris-flow gullies, landslides and seismic events relevant to the highway corridor. ScienceDB releases the collection free under CC BY 4.0. The inspected metadata does not establish a uniform temporal coverage or file format across all components. Recorded events, mapped physical features and potential hazard locations should remain distinct when building scenarios. The collection can help test road exposure and interacting flood or landslide disruptions, with separate intensity and fragility models. No directly related catalogue record was identified.
name: An inventory dataset of glacier and glacial lake related hazards (events) along the China-Pakistan Economic Corridor
